decisions.reason: After withdrawing the stand-alone fouling detection system C, management has consolidated its fouling R&D investment into the automation offer, which fits the announced digital-efficiency direction, so it persists despite some risk that A follows C.
The weir dimensioning web tool is cheap to maintain, supports the core flood-control business, and draws in engineering planners, so there is no reason to withdraw it.

The spring-controlled flap weir launched only in 2024 and sits close to the firm's established hydraulic steel engineering, so any weak early sales are attributed to long municipal procurement cycles.
The energy management system is central to the firm's publicly announced direction toward efficient, networked infrastructure with energy recovery, which creates strong commitment to keep it.
The overflow flap gate line is a multi-model investment shown on its own website page, making it a visible, core commitment that management will not abandon after one year.
